html:
I have been hanging around Zhihu for more than a year now, writing acoustics articles and answers in fits and starts but never quite stopping. Taking stock today, I was surprised by how much I had written.

The content falls roughly into three groups: popular acoustics, the history of acoustics, and acoustics as a field of study and work. I have listed the articles and answers below. Anyone interested in acoustics can use the list like a dictionary, and for me it doubles as a backup. I will update this page from time to time as new pieces appear.

You can also find me as Ziyu Acoustics on WeChat and on Toutiao, a Chinese news app:

Ziyu Acoustics

and in my Zhihu acoustics column of the same name:

Ziyu Acoustics
